hostname.description: System hostname to display in Monitorix web UI (leave blank to auto-detect)

base_url.description: URL path prefix for Monitorix web interface

lang.description: Default language for the web interface (e.g., en, de, fr)

cgi_buffer.description: Enable output buffering for CGI responses (recommended)

time_zone.description: System time zone for graph timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York')

ipv6_enabled.description: Listen on IPv6 addresses in addition to IPv4

lock_file.description: Path to the main Monitorix lockfile

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 = quiet, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose, 3 = debug

port.description: Port for Monitorix's built-in HTTP server

host.description: Host to bind to (empty = all interfaces). Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to localhost

server_exe.description: Path to Monitorix's CGI script for internal server mode

pid_file.description: Path to PID file for the built-in server

cgi_path.description: URL path to the Monitorix CGI script (for external server setups)

run_as_user.description: Non-root system user to run Monitorix as (security best practice)

tmp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files (must be writable by run_as_user)

bg_color.description: Graph background color in hex format

fg_color.description: Graph foreground/text color in hex format

border_color.description: Graph border color in hex format

default_time_range.description: Default time window (seconds) for graph display (e.g., 86400 = 24 hours)

rrd_base_dir.description: Directory where RRD files are stored

rrd_step.description: RRD data collection interval in seconds (min recommended: 30)

rrd_heartbeat.description: RRD heartbeat (seconds before data considered unknown)

enabled_system.description: Enable system metrics (CPU, memory, load, uptime)

uptime_cmd.description: Command used to get system uptime

enabled_disks.description: Enable disk usage and I/O monitoring

disks_to_monitor.description: List of disk/device names to monitor (e.g., sda, nvme0n1). Empty = auto-detect

interfaces_to_monitor.description: List of network interfaces to monitor. Empty = auto-detect (common: eth0, wlan0)

enabled_processes.description: Enable process count and resource monitoring

ss_cmd.description: Path to 'ss' command for port detection (alternatively: /sbin/lsof)

enabled_mail.description: Enable email alerts for threshold violations

smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname or IP (required if mail alerts enabled)

to_addrs.description: Comma-separated list of alert recipient email addresses

cpu_alert_threshold.description: CPU usage % threshold that triggers an alert (0–100)

mem_alert_threshold.description: Memory usage % threshold that triggers an alert (0–100)

load_alert_threshold.description: System load threshold (relative to CPU cores). E.g., 4 = 4× cores

enabled_alert.description: Enable custom alert script execution on threshold violations

alert_cmd.description: Command/script to execute when an alert fires (receives message via stdin)

enabled_apache.description: Enable Apache server metrics (requires Apache with mod_status)

apache_status_url.description: Apache server-status URL with '?auto' query parameter

apache_auth_user.description: HTTP Basic Auth username for Apache status URL (if protected)

apache_auth_pass.description: HTTP Basic Auth password for Apache status URL

enabled_mysql.description: Enable MySQL metrics (requires MySQL client tools)

mysql_user.description: MySQL username with REPLICATION CLIENT and PROCESS privileges

mysql_password.description: MySQL password (recommended: use ~/.my.cnf with client options)

enabled_nginx.description: Enable Nginx metrics (requires Nginx stub_status module)

enabled_logwatch.description: Enable log monitoring via Monitorix's built-in log parser

logwatch_config.description: Path to optional custom logwatch config file

log_files_to_monitor.description: List of log files to monitor for events (one per line in config)

items.description: Absolute path to a log file
